extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen-, surpass, overstep or going beyond, in file order. Unsurpassable goal (§§16, 38), overstepping (§37) and transcendent number (§68) are not the theme.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-1133): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Whether the judged objects are transcendent to consciousness or immanent makes no essential difference for the expression of acts.
units.quote: That the judged objects are in one case transcendent to consciousness (or claim to be) and in the other immanent makes here no essential difference.

absences.expected_because: The adumbration of the perceived object is where the distinction between objects transcendent to consciousness and immanent ones, named in §2, would bear on fulfilment.
